name: fhevm-sdk-workspace
//: - Workspace root. Private, never published. Holds the shared toolchain, shared config and the member list.
- The root fhevm workspace must never glob `sdk/*`, or members belong to two workspaces and hoist out of this one.
- js-sdk is not a member: it is still a root-workspace member. Consume it as a tarball until Step 2.
- hardhat-plugin/v2 and /v3 are not members either: they depend on js-sdk.
- Members are explicit paths, not globs. Only the CURRENT generation lists its `pkg/`: every payload
shares one published name, so v12/pkg is excluded while v13/pkg is a member (ARCHITECTURE.md I3).
- Older generations stay reachable through their harness: `@fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-dev-v12/pkg/...`,
which works only because harness manifests declare no `exports`. Never add one (I2).
- devDependencies here are the shared toolchain AND the two web3 libraries. ethers and viem are pinned
EXACTLY here and must not be redeclared by a member: a second range is how ethers ^6.16.0 and ^6.17.0
diverged between hardhat/v2 and the generations. Only dev-time declarations move here -- a published
payload still states its own contract, so hardhat/v2/pkg keeps its `ethers` peerDependency.
Genuinely package-specific deps (openzeppelin) stay in their package.
- `common/` is @fhevm/sdk-common-dev: private, never published, and importable ONLY by code that is
itself never published. It holds what every harness needs identically -- workspace layout, tarball
collection -- and nothing that a generation defines for itself. A `pkg/` importing it would ship an
unresolvable specifier; test:tarball:run is what catches that, so the boundary is enforced, not just
stated. It is a member so npm links it and consumers use a bare specifier.
- Tool versions must match sdk/js-sdk: a workspace hoists one copy, so the root pin wins for every member.
- prettier ^3.8.3 outranks the members' and js-sdk's ^3.6.2; all three resolve to one hoisted 3.9.x.
- No `type` field: hardhat-plugin/v2 is commonjs and v3 is esm, and a subpackage omitting its own would inherit it.
- engines >=22.6, not js-sdk's >=22.0: create2-deploy runs .ts on plain node, which needs type stripping.
- foundry.base.toml holds cross-generation POLICY (currently `[fmt]`), pulled in via `extends` in foundry.toml.

NOT compile settings: solc_version/evm_version are part of what each generation freezes. Editing it
    changes what check:vendored expects, because vendored sources are stored forge-formatted.
- scripts/ holds shared scripts, invoked by members as "$(npm prefix)/scripts/<name>". Shell where the
job is running other tools, plain ESM (.mjs) where it is real logic. It is deliberately not a workspace
member: a script is run by path, and an .mjs with only node builtins needs no module resolution either.
- pack:tarballs collects every member's .tgz into sdk/tarballs, so a package never packs its predecessor.
- `npm prefix` is this directory at any member depth. Not $INIT_CWD, which is wherever npm was invoked.
- Only this root may clear sdk/tarballs: a member sweeping it would delete another generation's tarball.
- clean:tarballs stays relative: a root script's cwd is always this dir, and an empty $(...) in rm -rf targets /.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run sync:vendored-ts && npm run prettier:check && npm run forge:fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && npm run clean:tarballs
scripts.check: npm run check:vendored-ts && npm run check:dep-versions && npm run check:tsconfig-paths && npm run check:pack-scripts
scripts.rebuild_and_test: npm run build && npm run test
